mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.25% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and INDPRO exceed their 1-year moving averages, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL below 2.5% YoY indicates low inflation, prompting sustained monetary accommodation that generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 2.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1200 thousand units (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand for housing, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1200, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100.0 (INDPRO) signals economic contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales above 440,000 million dollars (RSAFS) indicate sustained consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 440,000, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
